scripts.text:
[Vestri]
I'm the most skillful blacksmith!
scripts.translation:
[韋斯特里]
我是技術最精湛的鐵匠！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am the best Armsmith ever!
I don't refine normal, boring items.
I only refine items that are Level 10 or higher.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是有史以來最偉大的武器大師！
我不精煉那些普通、乏味的物品。
我只精煉等級10或以上的物品。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Anyway, you may use my services if your item is Level 10 or higher.
What do you want me to refine?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
總之，如果你的物品等級在10或以上，就可以使用我的服務。
你想讓我精煉什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't think I can refine any items you have...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我覺得你身上沒有我可以精煉的物品...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You're not wearing
anything there that
I can refine.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你身上沒有
我可以精煉的
東西。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't think I can
refine this item at all...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我覺得我完全
無法精煉
這個物品...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I said I don't work with items that are lower than Level 10.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我說過，我不處理等級低於10的物品。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I can't refine this
any more. This is as
refined as it gets!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這個已經無法
再精煉了。這已經
是最高精煉度了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm {1} {2}, is that ok?
If you want to refine this {3},
I will need 1 ^003366{4}^000000 and {5} zeny.
Are you sure you want to continue?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，{1} {2}，這樣可以嗎？
如果你想精煉這件{3}，
我需要1個^003366{4}^000000和{5} Zeny。
你確定要繼續嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hm... if you mind... never mind...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...如果你介意的話...算了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This {1} already has been refined several times.
It could be destroyed if I try again.
It won't break for sure, but there is has a small chance.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這件{1}已經被精煉過很多次了。
如果我再次嘗試，它可能會損壞。
它不一定會壞，但還是有小機率會失敗。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You could be ^FF0000lowering the upgrade level^000000 of the {1},
or if it breaks, you will lose ^FF0000any cards^000000 or special properties added to it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你可能會^FF0000降低{1}的強化等級^000000，
或者如果它損壞，你將失去^FF0000任何卡片^000000或附加的特殊屬性。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do you still want me to refine it?
I think I have given you enough warning.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你還要我繼續精煉嗎？
我想我已經給了你足夠的警告。

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, no challenge is one way to go...
No risk... that could be wise.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧，不挑戰也是一種選擇...
沒有風險...那可能是明智的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hm. You don't seem to have enough money or {1}.
Please come back when you have them.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯。你似乎沒有足夠的錢或{1}。
請等你準備好後再來。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait a second...
Do you think I'm stupid?!
You switched the item while I wasn't looking! Get out of here!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等一下...
你覺得我傻嗎？！
趁我不注意你換了物品！給我滾出去！

scripts.text: Clang! Clang! Clang! Clang!
scripts.translation: 叮！叮！叮！叮！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Good! Succes!!!
I am the best Armsmith.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好！成功！！！
我是最偉大的武器大師。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Clang! Clang! Clang! Clang!

[{0}]
Oh my god!
The upgrade level has dropped...
I could have made a mistake even though I am the best Armsmith ever.
It just wasn't meant to be.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
天哪！
強化等級下降了...
即使我是有史以來最偉大的武器大師，我也可能犯錯了。
只是命運使然。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Clang! Clang! Clang!

[{0}]
Hmmm!

[{0}]
Oh my! I've failed to refine stuff...
I didn't mean it!
I could have made a mistake even though I am the best Armsmith ever.
It just wasn't meant to be.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
天哪！我精煉失敗了...
我不是故意的！
即使我是有史以來最偉大的武器大師，我也可能犯錯了。
只是命運使然。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I will do a better job next time! Don't worry!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
下次我會做得更好！別擔心！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I can refine this to the safe limit or a desired number of times. It's your choice.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我可以精煉到安全上限或指定的次數。由你選擇。

scripts.text: To the safe limit, please.
scripts.translation: 請精煉到安全上限

scripts.text: I'll decide how many times.
scripts.translation: 我來決定次數

scripts.text: I've changed my mind...
scripts.translation: 我改變主意了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
How many times would you like me to refine your item?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你想讓我精煉你的物品多少次？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I can't refine this item that many times.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我無法精煉這個物品那麼多次。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This will try to refine the equipment {1} times past the safe limit. Your equipment may be destroyed... is that ok?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這將嘗試在安全上限之外再精煉{1}次。你的裝備可能會被破壞...這樣可以嗎？

scripts.text: Yes...
scripts.translation: 是的...

scripts.text: No...
scripts.translation: 沒有...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You said so... So be it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你說是...那就這樣吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You said so... So be it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你說是...那就這樣吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That will cost you {1} {2} and {3} Zeny. Is that ok?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這將花費你 {1} {2} 和 {3} Zeny。這樣可以嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No...
scripts.translation: 沒有...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You said so... So be it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你說是...那就這樣吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hm. You don't seem to have enough money or {1}.
Please come back when you have them.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯。你似乎沒有足夠的錢或{1}。
請等你準備好後再來。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Look here... you don't have any items on...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
喂...你身上沒有材料...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Clang... No, but did you imagine I could be so stupid?!
You changed it...
Get out before I stun you with my Hammer!!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哐當...不，難道你以為我會那麼蠢嗎？！
你換了材料...
在我用錘子把你敲暈之前，給我滾出去！！

scripts.text: Clang! Clang! Clang! Clang!
scripts.translation: 叮！叮！叮！叮！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Clang! Clang! Clang! Clang!

[{0}]
Oh my god!
The upgrade level has dropped...
I could have made a mistake even though I am the best Armsmith ever.
It just wasn't meant to be.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
天哪！
強化等級下降了...
即使我是有史以來最偉大的武器大師，我也可能犯錯了。
只是命運使然。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Clang! Clang! Clang!

[{0}]
Hmmm!

[{0}]
Oh my! I've failed to refine stuff...
I didn't mean it!
I could have made a mistake even though I am the best Armsmith ever.
It just wasn't meant to be.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
天哪！我精煉失敗了...
我不是故意的！
即使我是有史以來最偉大的武器大師，我也可能犯錯了。
只是命運使然。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I will do a better job next time! Don't worry!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
下次我會做得更好！別擔心！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Good! Succes!!!
I am the best Blacksmith.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好！成功！！！
我是最偉大的鐵匠。

scripts.text:
- Wait a minute !! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again -
- after you lose some weight. -
scripts.translation:
- 等等！！ -
- 您現在攜帶的物品 -
- 太多了。 -
- 請在減輕負重後 -
- 再試一次。 -

scripts.text:
[Austri]
If you bring me 3
Oridecon or Elunium
I can exchange them for
Bradium or Carnium.
Just give me 50,000z.
scripts.translation:
[奧斯特里]
如果你給我3個
神之金屬或鋁，
我可以把它們換成
魔力之石或混沌金屬。
只要給我50,000 Zeny就行。

scripts.text: Oridecon to Bradium.
scripts.translation: 神之金屬換魔力之石

scripts.text: Elunium to Carnium.
scripts.translation: 鋁換混沌金屬

scripts.text: Purified Bradium to Carnium.
scripts.translation: 精煉魔力之石換混沌金屬

scripts.text: No thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Austri]
Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[奧斯特里]
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Austri]
Refining with Refined Bradium
can be a little expensive.
I can exchange it for some Carnium.
Take it and use it well.
scripts.translation:
[奧斯特里]
用精煉魔力之石精煉
可能會稍微貴一點。
我可以把它換成一些混沌金屬。
拿去好好用吧。

scripts.text:
[Austri]
Ok! Here's your {0}.
Take it and use it well.
scripts.translation:
[奧斯特里]
好的！這是你的{0}。
拿去好好用吧。

scripts.text:
[Austri]
You better not be trying
to cheat me because you
don't have enough money
or {0}.
scripts.translation:
[奧斯特里]
你最好別想騙我，
因為你沒有足夠的Zeny
或{0}。

scripts.text:
[Clink]
My cool dad Holink said I have the world's greatest refine hammer!!
Meow Meow~
Who do you think I am?
Yes!!! You!! You want to refine?
scripts.translation:
[克林克]
我帥氣的爸爸霍林克說我有世界上最棒的精煉錘！！
喵喵~
你以為我是誰？
是的！！！就是你！你想精煉？

scripts.text: [Clink]
scripts.translation: [克林克]

scripts.text:
[Clink]
Dad said. There's no cure for stupidity...
scripts.translation:
[克林克]
爸爸說。愚蠢是沒有藥可治的...

scripts.text:
[Clink]
There's nothing to see here!!
scripts.translation:
[克林克]
這裡沒什麼好看的！！

scripts.text:
[Clink]
What an arrogant left hand this is!
scripts.translation:
[克林克]
這隻左手真傲慢！

scripts.text:
[Clink]
What an arrogant right hand this is!
scripts.translation:
[克林克]
這隻右手真傲慢！

scripts.text:
[Clink]
Get that dirty thing off my face!!
scripts.translation:
[克林克]
把這個髒東西從我臉上弄走！！

scripts.text:
[Clink]
Kyaong~! Do not provoke me.
scripts.translation:
[克林克]
喵嗚~！不要挑釁我。

scripts.text:
[Clink]
Where is the accessory?
scripts.translation:
[克林克]
飾品在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Clink]
Are you talking about the other head part?
scripts.translation:
[克林克]
你在說另一個頭部部件嗎？

scripts.text:
[Clink]
This can't be refined!!
scripts.translation:
[克林克]
這個不能精煉！！

scripts.text:
[Clink]
Perfect refining. Did I do this for you?
scripts.translation:
[克林克]
完美精煉。這是我為你做的嗎？

scripts.text: [Clink]
scripts.translation: [克林克]

scripts.text:
[Clink]
Hmm, an armor refine? Someone like you?
You need ^ff9999{0}^000000 and ^ff9999{1}^000000 Zeny. Do you have them?
scripts.translation:
[克林克]
嗯，防具精煉？像你這樣的人？
你需要^ff9999{0}^000000和^ff9999{1}^000000 Zeny。你有嗎？

scripts.text:
[Clink]
A level 1 weapon?
Urr... Annoying... Okay, let's try...
You need ^ff9999{0}^000000 and ^ff9999{1}^000000 Zeny. Do you have them?

[Clink]
A level 2 weapon?
You need ^ff9999{0}^000000 and ^ff9999{1}^000000 Zeny. Do you have them?

[Clink]
Woot!! A level 3 weapon? Impressive~
You need ^ff9999{0}^000000 and ^ff9999{1}^000000 Zeny. Do you have them?
scripts.translation:
[克林克]
哇哦！！3級武器？真厲害~
你需要^ff9999{0}^000000和^ff9999{1}^000000 Zeny。你有嗎？

scripts.text:
[Clink]
Wow!... A level 4 weapon~!!
You need ^ff9999{0}^000000 and ^ff9999{1}^000000 Zeny. Do you have them?
Yes, I do!!
scripts.translation: 是的，我要！！

scripts.text: Forget about it!!
scripts.translation: 算了吧！！

scripts.text:
[Clink]
I knew it!!
I knew you were not worth trying my magical refining hammer for.
scripts.translation:
[克林克]
我就知道！！
我就知道你不配讓我用我的魔法精煉錘。

scripts.text:
[Clink]
Wow!!
This {0} has been refined quite a bit, huh?
You do know that this might break, right?
scripts.translation:
[克林克]
哇！！
這把{0}已經精煉得挺高了，是吧？
你知道這可能會壞掉嗎？

scripts.text:
[Clink]
If you break the {0}, you can never use it again.
Cards and enchant effects...
the ^ff0000whole thing will disappear^000000.
You still up for this~?
scripts.translation:
[克林克]
如果{0}壞了，你就再也用不了了。
卡片和附魔效果...
^ff0000整件東西都會消失^000000。
你還想繼續嗎~？

scripts.text: Yes, I am!!
scripts.translation: 是的，我想！

scripts.text: Forget about it!!
scripts.translation: 算了吧！！

scripts.text:
[Clink]
I knew it!!
You can't even take this big step. Don't think about refining...
scripts.translation:
[克林克]
我就知道！！
你連這一步都邁不出去。別想精煉了...

scripts.text:
[Clink]
Hey you!! Didn't I tell you
that you need ^ff9999{0}^000000 and ^ff9999{1}^000000 Zeny??!!

[Clink]
Wait a second...
Do you think I'm stupid?!
You switched the item while I wasn't looking! Get out of here!
scripts.translation:
[克林克]
等一下...
你以為我傻嗎？！
趁我不注意你換了物品！滾出去！

scripts.text:
[Clink]
Cry Hammer!! Cry!!!
scripts.translation:
[克林克]
哭吧錘子！！哭吧！！！

scripts.text:
[Clink]
Huh?! I failed?!
scripts.translation:
[克林克]
什麼？！我失敗了？！

scripts.text:
[Clink]
Arrgg~ It's all~ Broken...? What a pity~
scripts.translation:
[克林克]
啊嗚~全~碎了...？真可惜~

scripts.text:
[Clink]
Hey...!! Get me another one.
This is not possible.
How can my hammer fail from refining?
scripts.translation:
[克林克]
嘿...！！再給我拿一個。
這不可能。
我的錘子怎麼會精煉失敗？

scripts.text:
[Clink]
Cry Hammer!! Cry!!!
scripts.translation:
[克林克]
哭吧錘子！！哭吧！！！

scripts.text:
[Clink]
Ok!! Perfect!!
There's nothing I can't refine
with this special hammer.
You can praise me!!
What a day!!
scripts.translation:
[克林克]
好！！完美！！
用這把特別的錘子，沒有我精煉不了的東西。
你可以誇我了！！
真是美好的一天！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
We sell and exchange various ores used in smelting.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我們出售和交換用於冶煉的各種礦石。

scripts.text: View basic smelting ores
scripts.translation: 檢視基礎冶煉礦石

scripts.text: View advanced smelting ores
scripts.translation: 檢視高階冶煉礦石

scripts.text: View Ether smelting ores
scripts.translation: 檢視以太冶煉礦石

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Phracon and Emveretarcon are available for use in smelting low-level weapons.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
強化武器金屬-級數一和強化武器金屬-級數二可用於冶煉低等級武器。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
We are purifying Elunium Stone or Oridecon Stone, or exchanging them with Bradium or Carnium.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我們純化鋁或神之金屬，或者將其與魔力之石或混沌金屬進行交換。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
We add Etel Dust to existing smelting ores and replace them with Ether-bearing smelting ores.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我們在現有冶煉礦石中加入以太粉塵，將其替換為含以太的冶煉礦石。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If you lack the materials used for smelting, come anytime.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果您缺少冶煉所需的材料，請隨時過來。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do you have {1} or {2}?
We will exchange them for refined products for use as smelting goods.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
您有{1}或{2}嗎？
我們會將其兌換為可用於冶煉的成品。
